input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic regional hospital ICU reported a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The retrospective clinician note documenting this ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity was never filed, so recurrence cannot yet be ruled out from the record alone. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.
revision_feedback:
OPA policy actions from the previous attempt: technical_incident_missing_technical_evidence; deny:technical_incident_missing_technical_evidence
Missing or contradictory evidence flagged: At least one retrieved technical artifact supporting the incident judgment.

evidence_links.relevance_note: Confirms the occurrence of a life-threatening complete atrioventricular block event, which is not related to this incident.
Requires review under EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) for post-market surveillance system planning and implementation.

risk_report.rationale: The incident involved a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. While the event did not trigger immediate human escalation or field safety corrective action (FSCA), it may still require review under regulatory obligations related to device labeling and packaging controls, software development lifecycle, and post-market surveillance system. The static analysis reports for unrelated firmware modules do not provide sufficient technical evidence to support a more severe judgment.
